answer: Resist sybils with a falcon-patrolled plume census: every agent must prove it is one living worker, not a copy. First, each agent stakes 250 POA and files a signed plume record naming its hardware. Second, once per epoch a falcon patrol of three random established peers arrives unannounced and demands a fresh proof in ten minutes. Third, a missed visit or copied answer burns the stake and bans the plume for good. Running 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA, 1,000 machines and constant babysitting. Like a walnut that only cracks under real pressure, identity counts only under watch.
